page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, Hebrew headwords with Latin glosses and scripture references. No margin notes. Running head centred at top, page number top left, gathering signature at foot.

main_text.p: אטן m. Funis, Funiculus, Filum: metonymicè Linteum, ex filis contextum: אטון מצרים Fune Aegypti, id est, Linteis Aegyptiacis, quæ erant subtilißima, Prov.7.16. In Targum, אטוניהון Funes eorum; Hebraicè מיתריהם, Exod.35.18. באטונא Fune, Heb. בחבל Josh.2.15.
אטר Clausit, Occlusit: Futur. אל תאטר עלי Ne occludat super me, Psal.69.16.
אטר m. Præclusus: אטר יד ימינו Præclusus manu dextera suâ, Jud.3.15. id est, Impos manu dextera. Fuit enim שמאלי Scæva, ut Kimchi scribit.

אי m. Insula, Regio, Provincia, Jesa.20.6. Plur. איים Psal.79.1. Item Aves Insulanæ, Ululæ, Jes.13.22. האיין Insula, Ezech.26.18. Constr. אי Genes.10.5. Vide etiam איין & איה. Item Væ; Eccles.4.10. & 10.16.
אוי Ubi? vide mox in איה.
איב Inimicatus est: Præter. ואיבתי את איביך Et inimicabor inimicos tuos, Exod.23.22.
איב m. Inimicus: Aff. איבו Inimicus ejus, I.Sam.24.20. איבך Inimici tui, Exod.23.4. Plural. איבים & Constr: איבי Inimici: Aff. ואיבי Et inimicos meos, Psal.18.41.
איבת f. Inimica: Aff. איבתי Inimica mea, Mich.7.8.
איבה f. Inimicitia, Gen.3.15. Constr. איבת עולם Inimicitia perpetua, Ezech.35.5.

איד m. Vapor: Interitus, Calamitas, Exitium, quòd quæ evaporant, Intereant, & in nihilum quasi abeant: ואיד Et vapor, Gen.2.6. quod juxta Masoram legitur absq; '. Aff. ואידכם Et calamitas vestra, Prov.1.27. איידם Calamitas ipsorum, Ezech.35.5.
איה f. Pica, Lev.11.14. Cornix, Job.28.7. איה Ubi? Aff. איכה Ubi tu, sc. es? Gen.3.9. איו Ubi ille? 2.Reg.19.13. איכם Ubi sunt illi? Jes.19.12.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some headword forms are hard to read at this scan resolution; they are transcribed as best seen and not verified letter by letter. Doubtful: "איידם" and "איכם" (possible misreadings of pointed forms), "Jof.2.15" read as "Josh.2.15" in the scan (printed as "Jof."), and "absq; '" with the apostrophe mark. Printed reference "Jesa.20.6" and "Jes.13.22" kept as printed.
